title: Full-Time B2B Sales Closer — US Market | AI Agency | Leads, Dialer & Scripts Provided | Base + 15% Commission
description:
TYPE OF WORK: Full Time

WAGE / SALARY: $500/mo trial base ? $700–$1,000/mo standard base + 15% commission (uncapped, minimum 150$ per close, up to hundreds more depending on service tier sold)

HOURS PER WEEK: 40

JOB OVERVIEW

PixelAscend is an AI automation agency helping businesses with AI receptionists, chatbots, missed-call recovery, customer support automation, and sales automation. We're hiring a full-time remote Sales Closer from the Philippines for a long-term role calling US businesses.

We provide the leads, dialer, scripts, and training — your job is to contact prospects, get past gatekeepers, book and run qualified calls, pitch our services clearly, and close.

This is a full-cycle closing role, not appointment setting. You own deals from first contact to signed client.

WHO THIS IS FOR

You're confident on the phone, you don't fold when a gatekeeper says "the owner isn't around," and you can explain a simple service to a US business owner without sounding like you're reading a script. You want to close — not just dial.

RESPONSIBILITIES



Contact US business leads by phone,
, and LinkedIn

Get past gatekeepers and reach the actual decision-maker

Book and run qualified sales calls

Close interested prospects

Keep CRM notes updated; send short daily activity updates

Report objections and lead-quality feedback



REQUIREMENTS



Strong spoken and written English with a clear, US-business-fluent phone presence

Proven experience cold-calling US businesses (B2B preferred)

Comfortable handling gatekeepers and objections

Reliable: strong internet, quiet work setup, backup power/connection a plus

Able to work a permanent night shift (see schedule)

Full-time availability



BONUS SKILLS



Sold SaaS, agency, automation, or AI services before

Experience with dialers, Apollo, LinkedIn, CRM tools, Google Sheets

Background in B2B services sales to US SMBs (home services, clinics, contractors, salons, etc.)



COMPENSATION



Trial base: $500/month (prorated) during the paid trial period

Standard base: $700–$1,000/month once you clear the trial and close your first client — grows with performance

15% commission on collected client payments (setup fee + first monthly retainer), uncapped

Base paid monthly; long-term role for the right person



HOW THIS ROLE STARTS (please read carefully)

We run a staged paid trial so strong closers get rewarded fast and the wrong fit is caught early:



Days 1–3 (paid): ramp + first outreach. Target: book qualified, confirmed demos (right decision-maker, real interest, locked time slot).

Weeks 1–2 (paid): build a consistent qualified pipeline.

Weeks 3–4 (paid): close at least one client by the end of the first sales cycle.



Full base pay throughout, clear targets, and a long-term seat plus the standard base for whoever clears them. If you set appointments but never close, this isn't your seat.

SCHEDULE



Full-time, Monday–Friday

US business hours (night shift in PH): approx. 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM PHT, targeting US Eastern/Central morning-to-afternoon — the prime B2B calling window

This is a permanent night-shift role — only apply if you can reliably work these hours long-term



HOW TO APPLY (generic copy-paste applications are ignored)



Your B2B sales / cold-calling experience + CV/resume

What clients or services you've sold before, and confirmation you've called US businesses

Your expected monthly base salary

When you can start

A short voice / video recording: introduce yourself and give a 30-second mock pitch for an "AI receptionist that answers missed calls 24/7" for a US small business. This is the most important part — it shows us how you sound to a business owner.

title: Senior Amazon FBA OA Sourcer
description:
Role Details

Compensation: 1,000 USD/month

Location: Fully Remote

Schedule: Monday to Friday, flexible PH business hours

Employment Type: Full-time

Pay Frequency: Bi-weekly



About the Role

We are a US-based Amazon FBA seller with 6 years in the business, primarily in electronics and tech. The store is stable and profitable, and we are looking for a senior OA sourcer who can come in and contribute from day one - not someone we need to train from the ground up.



This is a long-term role. Our senior VA has been with us for over 4 years and that is the kind of working relationship we want to build again. You will work directly with our senior VA, submit leads through our internal platform, and be trusted to make sourcing decisions independently. If you are the type who figures things out on your own, brings your own knowledge to the table, and actually enjoys the hunt - this is for you.



What you will do

Find online arbitrage leads through manual sourcing - you know which sites to check, when to check them, and what to look for without being told

Use reverse sourcing to bring in new suppliers and brands, including ones you have already worked with in previous roles

Evaluate every lead properly using Keepa - sales rank trends, offer count, price history, seasonality - before submitting anything

Submit leads through our internal platform with full details (buy cost, sell price, ROI, source link)

Proactively flag new opportunities, restocks, and time-sensitive deals without waiting to be asked

Communicate clearly on 
 - leads, questions, updates, anything relevant

Keep track of what has been submitted, approved, and rejected so you are not posting the same leads twice



What we need

Minimum 5 years of OA sourcing experience for a US Amazon FBA store

You can read a Keepa chart properly - rank trends, offer count drops, seasonal spikes, you know what you are looking at

You have a real sourcing process for both manual and reverse sourcing - sites you trust, brands you know, methods that work

Strong understanding of buy box mechanics, orphan ASINs, seasonality, and supply and demand dynamics

title: Legal AI Product Tester / Legal QA Analyst
description:
Legal AI Product Tester / Legal QA Analyst



Remote | Contract | Philippines-Based Preferred



About the Role



Irys is looking for lawyers or legally trained professionals to test our legal AI platform on a daily basis. This role is focused on stress-testing legal AI workflows across litigation, corporate, transactional, research, drafting, and document-review use cases.



You will use your own legal judgment, test sets, sample documents, pleadings, contracts, memos, and research tasks to evaluate whether the system produces accurate, useful, well-structured, and lawyer-reviewable work product.



This is not a passive QA role. We need someone who can think like a lawyer, identify what went wrong, explain why it matters, and structure feedback clearly for our product and AI teams.



Responsibilities



Test Irys legal AI workflows daily across different legal tasks.

Bring and create realistic test sets, including pleadings, contracts, memos, client
s, research questions, diligence materials, and mixed document bundles.

Evaluate outputs for legal accuracy, factual grounding, completeness, structure, tone, formatting, and usefulness.

Identify hallucinations, missed facts, weak reasoning, unsupported claims, bad drafting choices, citation problems, and confusing product behavior.

Compare outputs across different modes, prompts, models, and workflows.

Provide structured feedback with clear issue descriptions, severity levels, screenshots, source references, and recommended fixes.

Work closely with product, engineering, and AI teams to reproduce issues and improve the system.

Help define testing rubrics and repeatable evaluation sets for future benchmarking.



What You Should Be Testing For



Did the system understand the uploaded documents?

Did it extract the right facts and miss anything important?

Did it distinguish between fact, law, argument, risk, and client narrative?

Did it cite or reference sources correctly?

Did it draft in the right legal format?

Did it over-admit, overstate, hallucinate, or make unsupported conclusions?

Did it produce something a lawyer could actually review and use?

Did the workflow make sense from a user perspective?

Did any internal/debug language appear in the final output?

Did the product behave reliably across repeated tests?



Qualifications



Law degree or substantial legal training required.

Strong familiarity with U.S. legal documents, pleadings, motions, contracts, legal memos, and common law reasoning strongly preferred.

Experience with U.S., U.K., Australian, Singaporean, or other common law legal work is a plus.

Litigation and/or corporate/transactional experience preferred.

Strong legal writing and analytical skills.

Excellent attention to detail.

Comfortable testing software, documenting bugs, and giving precise feedback.

Ability to work independently and test consistently without needing constant direction.

Interest in legal AI, legal technology, and product development.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is a legally trained operator who can test like a lawyer and think like a product reviewer. You should be comfortable saying:



This answer is legally wrong.

This draft is useful but not filing-ready.

This missed a key fact.

This cited the wrong source.

This workflow is confusing.

This is a serious issue versus a minor polish issue.



Engagement



Remote contract role.

Part-time or full-time depending on fit and availability.

Daily testing expected.

Paid trial period may be required.

Must be able to provide structured written feedback in clear English.



To Apply



Please send:



Resume or LinkedIn profile.

Short summary of your legal background.

Jurisdictions or legal systems you are familiar with.

Examples of legal documents or workflows you would be comfortable testing.

Availability and expected hourly or monthly rate.

Any prior experience with AI tools, legal tech, QA, or product testing.

What You'll Do

• Schedule and process payments via ACH, check, and credit card in accordance with payment terms and company policy.

• Perform credit card reconciliation, matching transactions to receipts and statements on a regular basis.

• Maintain and update the accounts payable ledger, ensuring all entries are accurate and up to date.

• Communicate with vendors to resolve discrepancies, missing invoices, or payment inquiries in a timely manner.

• Assist in month-end closing activities including AP aging reports and account reconciliations.

• Ensure all payments are processed before due dates to avoid late fees or penalties.

• Maintain organized and accurate filing of all AP documentation, both digital and physical.

• Collaborate with the Treasury and Finance teams to ensure proper cash flow management.

• Adhere to internal AP policies and procedures, including the payment threshold authorization guidelines.

 

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• At least 1-3 years of experience in Accounts Payable or a related finance/accounting role.

• Hands-on experience with credit card reconciliation, this is a key requirement for this role.

• Experience working with multiple entities or business units simultaneously.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting or AP software (e.g., QuickBooks, 
, Ramp, or similar platforms).

• Excellent attention to detail and high level of accuracy in data entry and financial processing.

Preferred Qualifications

What to Expect

Work Environment

• This is a fully remote position. You will be working with a US-based healthcare operations team across multiple facilities and entities.

• You will collaborate closely with the AP team, Treasury, and Finance departments on a daily basis.

• Your schedule will be 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM PST, Monday through Friday - reliability and punctuality are essential.

 

Volume & Pace

• This is a high-volume AP environment. You can expect to process a large number of invoices and transactions on a daily basis.

• You will be managing payments for multiple entities simultaneously, so strong multitasking and prioritization skills are a must.

 

Compensation & Benefits

• Competitive entry-level monthly salary with the possibility of a yearly salary increase based on performance.

• Stable, long-term remote work opportunity with a growing US-based healthcare organization.

title: Video Editor
description:
ABOUT US

Fullmer Consulting Media is the content team behind Logan Fullmer — a real estate investor and entrepreneur with 290,000+ followers across Instagram, YouTube, and
. We produce high-volume, formula-driven content: property tours, deal breakdowns, AI-powered reels, podcast clips, and entrepreneur content.



We run a structured production system. Every format has a defined template, every edit starts with a clear brief, and every editor receives specific feedback. We're scaling fast and hiring 2–3 reliable overseas editors to grow with us.



---



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit short-form content (Instagram Reels, TikTok,
) in Adobe Premiere Pro and CapCut following provided templates and shot-by-shot briefs

- Edit long-form content (YouTube videos, podcast episodes) per format guides

- Apply hooks, pacing cuts, captions, lower thirds, and safe zones exactly as briefed

- Deliver files formatted and labeled per platform specs (aspect ratios, file naming, caption burn-ins)

- Submit edits within agreed turnaround windows (typically 24–48 hours)

- Accept feedback clearly and apply revisions quickly



---



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years of video editing experience (short-form social and/or long-form YouTube/podcast)

- Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro (required) and CapCut (required)

- Strong English reading comprehension — briefs and feedback are in English

- Reliable internet and ability to send/receive large video files

- Comfortable working remotely and asynchronously without constant supervision

- Able to follow a template or style guide precisely and consistently



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with real estate or business/entrepreneur content

- Familiarity with AI video tools (Kling, Veo 3, HeyGen, ElevenLabs)

- Experience clipping short-form content from long-form interviews or podcasts



---



WHY THIS ROLE

- Every project comes with a detailed brief and reference edits — no guessing what "good" means

- Consistent volume every month — reliable editors move from project-based to retainer

- Specific, actionable feedback — we invest in making editors better over time

- Clear expectations, stable workflows, and a structured global team



---



HOW TO APPLY

Please send the following:



1. Portfolio or reel link — must include at least 5 examples of short-form social content (Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts) and 1 example of long-form content

2. Brief intro (3–5 sentences): who you are, where you're located, your experience, and your availability

3. List of tools you use regularly

4. Your typical turnaround time for a 60–90 second Reel edit from raw footage



Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid test week before any offer is made.

*Work ethic

*Reliability

*Passion for social media and content creation



Gen Z applicants or Gen Z at heart are strongly encouraged to apply.

Why Join Us?

* Work on content seen by massive audiences

This role is perfect for creators who want to go beyond casual editing and become genuinely skilled at creating content that performs online.



How to Apply



Please send us:

1. A short 1–2 minute video introduction explaining why you’d be a good fit for this role

!!! Applications without a video introduction will not be reviewed !!!

nt in a podcast conversation, or turning a collection of raw clips into something that actually moves people, we want to hear from you.

mber, collaborating closely with our producers and attending weekly work in progress meetings via video call. You'll need to be available during Melbourne business hours (AEST) for calls, approvals, and team communication.

mber, not a freelancer

title: GEO/SEO Virtual Assistant (Execution & Delivery)
description:
About us

We're an AI and SEO startup helping companies get found, not just on Google but on AI driven platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews. This emerging field is called GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and it's where search is heading. We work with growth minded businesses that want to stay visible as discovery shifts from blue links to AI answers. Founded by a serial entrepreneur who has built and scaled multiple ventures, the company is small, fast, and built for the new era of AI enabled search.

The role

This is a delivery and execution role. The strategy is handled. What we need is someone who makes sure the work actually ships: audits run on schedule, fixes get implemented, reports go out, and nothing slips through the cracks across a growing list of retainer clients.

You're detail oriented, technically strong, and the kind of person who finishes what they start and keeps systems running without being chased. You'll execute, audit, and improve technical SEO and GEO performance across multiple client sites, and you'll help build the workflows and SOPs that keep everything reproducible as we grow.

A new way of working

You'll work in a modern, AI first stack. We run client activity through Claude as our primary system of record, and we use Claude Code, Claude Cowork, SSH, and WP-CLI to do the actual GEO and SEO work. If that's new to you, good. I'll teach and train you in this new way of working while leaning hard on the SEO experience you already have. The one non-negotiable is that you're genuinely open to working differently.

Responsibilities



Run technical SEO and GEO audits using tools like Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and GA4.

Identify and fix issues with crawlability, indexation, page speed, sitemaps, schema, and canonicalization.

Optimize site structure, internal linking, and Core Web Vitals.

Implement structured data and schema markup to improve visibility on both search engines and AI answer engines.

Support GEO and AEO work, optimizing client visibility on ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI Overviews.

Monitor rankings, traffic, and technical performance, and turn the data into clear summaries and recommendations.

Execute on-page and technical deliverables for client sites, on time, every time.

Document processes and maintain clean, reproducible workflows and SOPs.



Qualifications



4+ years of hands-on technical SEO experience (agency or freelance).

Strong with the core tools: Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, GA4, Google Search Console.

Solid grasp of HTML, XML sitemaps, 
, and core web technologies.

Comfortable in WordPress (Divi a plus) and familiar with other major CMS platforms.

Clear written communication and strong organizational skills.

Reliable and self-managing: you track your own commitments and hit deadlines without reminders.

Bonus: experience with AI search platforms, GEO/AEO strategy, or prompt writing.



Hours & compensation



Part-time to start: roughly 20 hours per week, with a clear path to full time as the client base grows.

Remote, flexible schedule.

Competitive hourly rate based on experience and results.



Why join



Direct access to the founder. You work with me, not through layers.

A front-row seat to GEO, the next frontier of search visibility.

Real ownership over systems and delivery from day one.

Core values that actually matter here: be kind to one another, be generous, and always be learning.



How to apply



Send 2 to 3 examples of technical SEO projects or audits you've worked on.

Include a short note on any experience with AI driven search (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity).

Share a screenshot of your Kolbe A result if you have one.

To show you read this all the way through, in the first sentence of your reply to me, tell me cherries are your favorite fruit.

title: ADVICE ASSOCIATE  (URGENT - Please apply ONLY if you have experience in financial advice)
description:
ADVICE ASSOCIATE - FINANCIAL ADVICE INDUSTRY

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time

Salary: $10-$15ph



ABOUT LIFE UNSHACKLED

LifeUnshackled is a platform built to help people reclaim the life they once dreamed of, clients and team alike. We exist because “retire comfortably” is not the goal, freedom is. We bring bold financial strategy and strong follow-through so clients can build real wealth and live life on their terms. You will be joining a growth-minded team that cares about ambition, high standards, and doing work that genuinely helps people unshackle their lives.



ABOUT THE ROLE

The Associate is the operational and relational lead for their assigned clients, acting as the Chief Operating Officer of each client relationship. This role combines precision in data and document management, project management discipline, people and communication skills, hands-on platform execution, and a delegation mindset. Each Associate is responsible for ensuring timely, compliant, and high-quality delivery of financial advice implementation and client outcomes, in coordination with the broader LifeUnshackled team.



FOUR KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITIES

1. The Information Steward

- Custodian of all essential client information and access rights.

- Curate and maintain a “Client Support Pack” with critical data and supporting documents for rapid use in preparing application forms. This includes identity documents (individuals and entities), FATCA, ABNs, ACNs, TFNs, ESAs, bank accounts, wholesale certificates, etc.

- Collect and store tax-related and performance-related documentation (e.g. holding, distribution, loan, rental, annual, market value, tax statements).

- Maintain and enforce the standard client folder structure, file naming conventions, and financial year categorisation so that files are audit-ready at all times.

- Own the client Fact Find end-to-end — keeping it current after every meeting, statement, or client communication, and ensuring it underpins all advice documents as an auditable chain of evidence.

- Monitor and update the real-time client balance sheet, sourcing data from various platforms and reconciling across systems quarterly.

- Ensure adviser access and login credentials are in place and securely managed across all relevant platforms.

- Collaborate with the PSM to standardise and streamline information management.

- Mindset: “Would I be confident this is clean and client-ready at any time?”



2. The Delivery Project Manager

- Leader of accurate client service implementation and delivery timelines.

- Ensure investment transactions are implemented same-day and insurance applications are begun within 48 hours of approval.

- Turn meeting actions and strategic goals into clearly written, trackable tasks — nothing falls through the cracks.

- Own timelines and deadlines — chasing overdue tasks, flagging bottlenecks, and ensuring every task reaches a clear resolution.

- Delegate technical or administrative tasks appropriately while owning the outcome.

- Coordinate closely with paraplanners, the Practice Support Manager, the Principal Adviser, and external professionals.

- Ensure documents and forms are completed correctly, on time, and sent to the right parties.

- Mindset: “What’s needed to move this forward without needing Principal involvement?”



3. The Relationship Anchor

- Point of continuity, context, and connection for each client.

- Understand the needs and preferences of your clients and orchestrate effective service delivery accordingly.

- Be the primary internal advocate and coordinator for your clients.

- Track developments in the client’s personal and financial life.

- Stay across all meeting notes and ensure task systems reflect meetings.

- Notice changes in goals, mindset, or relationships and raise them with the Principal.

- Support the Principal by ensuring they are well-informed before every meeting.

- Ensure the client never has to repeat themselves or chase us for updates.

- Mindset: “What’s shifted for the client that we haven’t yet actioned?”



4. The Compliant Storyteller

- Ensuring each client file tells a compelling and compliant story.

- Keep client files audit-ready with consistent, clear, and updated notes.

- Manage the full post-meeting workflow: consent and transcription, file note generation and review, follow-up
s, and updating the Fact Find with any new information.

- Ensure fact finds, SOAs, ROAs, and client communications are accurate and well-organised.

- Maintain clarity in the chronology and context of advice decisions.

- Highlight progress and transformation in the client’s journey, tying actions back to their goals.

- Ensure documentation not only meets compliance and privacy standards but tells the narrative of value delivered.

- Mindset: “Would this file make sense to an outsider, showing a clear and compliant story of impact?”



PRIORITISATION ORDER

- From a business perspective, your tasks should be prioritised in the following order:

- Cash / investment transacting, including opening of associated accounts and completion of any KYC / onboarding requirements with third parties where this would delay a cash / investment transaction.

- Insurance applications and getting policies into force.

- Preparing meeting summaries and post-meeting
s for your clients, and any sub-10-minute tasks that are directly requested of you by the Principal Adviser.

- Responding to requests made of us by other professionals (we expect fast responses from them and should return the favour).

- Other work pertaining to clients who are in their first 6 weeks with us (including onboarding).

- Other work pertaining to your broader client list, prioritised by the annual fee that they are paying us and any relationship considerations (including preparing their reports / maintaining their client file with current information / supporting loan applications / etc).

- Balance this priority list with approaching deadlines — as deadlines near, the work becomes a higher priority.

title: Property Appraiser / BPO Review Specialist (Remote/Part Time/Night Shift)

Schedule:

Rate: $9 USD/Hour

Compensation: Competitive USD-based hourly + PTO + Paid US Holidays



Job Overview:

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Property Appraiser / BPO Review Specialist to review Broker Price Opinions (BPO), property valuations, and comparable sales used by agents and service providers.



This role is ideal for someone with strong property appraisal experience who can carefully review submitted BPOs, identify inaccurate or weak comparable properties, and question valuation conclusions that are not properly supported.



The Property Appraiser / BPO Review Specialist will play a key role in helping ensure property values are accurate, realistic, and supported by strong market data. The right candidate must be confident enough to professionally push back on service providers when the comps provided are incorrect, incomplete, outdated, or do not support the recommended property value. This person should be able to clearly explain why a comp is not appropriate and request better supporting examples when needed.





Key Responsibilities:



BPO Review and Property Valuation

• Review agent-submitted Broker Price Opinions for accuracy, completeness, and reasonableness

• Analyze comparable sales used to support property values conclusions

• Check whether comps are appropriate based on location, property type, size, age, condition, sale date, and market activity

• Identify weak, inaccurate, outdated, or poorly matched comparable properties

• Review valuation conclusions and determine whether they are properly supported by market data

• Flag inconsistencies, errors, or missing information in BPO reports



Comparable Sales Analysis

• Evaluate whether selected comps are truly comparable to the subject property

• Question comps that are too far away, too old, physically different, or not relevant to the local market

• Recommend better comparable properties when available

• Provide clear examples to support requested corrections or valuation concerns

• Help ensure property values are realistic, defensible, and supported by market data



Service Provider Review and Communication

• Communicate professionally with agents, vendors, or service providers regarding BPO concerns

• Push back when submitted comps or valuation conclusions are inaccurate or unsupported

• Request better comps, corrections, or additional explanation when needed

• Clearly explain valuation issues in writing using objective, evidence-based reasoning

• Maintain a firm but professional tone when challenging incorrect reports





Document and Quality Control 

• Document valuation concerns, comp issues, and recommended corrections

• Maintain organized records of reviewed BPOs and appraisal-related findings

• Support internal decision-making by providing reliable valuation feedback

• Help improve review standards and valuation quality over time

• Ensure all appraisal review work is accurate, consistent, and completed on time



Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience in property appraisal, real estate valuation, BPO review, CMA review, or similar real estate analysis work

• Strong understanding of comparable sales analysis

• Experience reviewing property values, appraisal reports, BPOs, or real estate market data

• Ability to evaluate property values based on market conditions and property characteristics

• Experience with US real estate, US property markets, or US-based real estate clients is strongly preferred

• Excellent written English communication skills

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

• Confident personality with the ability to push back when information is inaccurate or incomplete

• Able to work independently in a remote environment



Preferred Skills:

• Experience reviewing BPOs for US-based real estate companies, investors, lenders, or property management firms

• Experience working with agents, brokers, appraisers, or valuation service providers

• Familiarity with MLS data, Zillow, Redfin, 
, PropStream, or similar real estate tools

• Ability to identify market trends and value inconsistencies

• Strong research skills

• Comfortable questioning reports and asking for better supporting data

• Organized, reliable, and able to meet deadlines



Logistics & Compensation:

description:
Amazon FBA Sourcing & Operations Manager

Location: Remote / Permanent Work-From-Home Employment Type: Full-time, 8 hours/day, 5 days/week



Compensation & Benefits

Role Overview We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Amazon FBA Sourcing & Operations Manager to oversee our Online Arbitrage (OA) supply chain and daily seller account health. In this consolidated role, you will be the gatekeeper for our capital—auditing leads, executing purchases, managing supplier logistics, and maintaining the operational health of our Amazon storefront.



Core Responsibilities

1. Lead Auditing & Sourcing Management

• Lead Verification: Manually audit 100% of the leads generated by Sourcing VAs against strict profitability criteria before approving them into the 3P Lead Vault and authorizing capital.

• Cost Analysis: Accurately calculate all add-on product costs, including inbound shipping, prep center fees, and Amazon FBA fees, to ensure true ROI targets are met.

• Lead Vault Re-Mining: Mine the historical Lead Database daily to identify previously non-performing leads that have shifted back into our profitability range due to market volatility.

• Buylist Preparation: Prepare Daily Buylists on 3P Mercury, organizing new ASINs from sourcing leads and identifying re-stocking opportunities based on historical sales performance and inventory velocity.



2. Purchasing & Supplier Management

• Supplier Validation: Thoroughly vet new suppliers to verify their legitimacy, stock availability, and shipping lead times to prevent tied-up capital.

• Order Execution: Execute orders strictly adhering to approved sourcing criteria, quantity limits, maximum cost-per-order, and daily spend limits provided by management.

• Documentation & Tracking: Complete purchases and immediately attach all receipts, invoices, and tracking numbers to the 3P master tracking system.



3. Logistics & Prep Center Coordination

• Reconciliation: Cross-reference supplier orders against prep center receiving reports to ensure 100?curacy.

• Issue Resolution: Follow up directly with suppliers to track missing orders or quantities. Identify damaged or mismatched stock, initiate return requests, and secure refunds.

• Routing: Coordinate shipping documentation, FNSKU labels, and carton labels directly with the prep center to ensure smooth transition of inventory into Amazon fulfillment centers.



4. Account Management & Health

• Inventory Management: Monitor stranded inventory, unfulfillable units, and restock limits.

• Account Health: Routinely monitor the Account Health Dashboard to proactively address and resolve IP complaints, authenticity claims (especially within gated categories), and negative feedback.

• Pricing Strategy: Oversee and adjust repricer settings to maintain Buy Box share and maximize margins.



Requirements & Qualifications

• Extensive experience working in an Amazon Online Arbitrage (OA) business model.

• Expert-level proficiency in reading and analyzing Keepa charts (sales rank velocity, buy box history, offer counts, and price history).

• Familiarity with standard Amazon seller software stack (e.g., 3P Mercury, ArbiSource, SellerBoard, Seller Snap).

• Bonus: Previous experience sourcing and managing compliance for the Beauty & Personal Care categories.

• Strong English communication skills for supplier outreach and team coordination.

• Exceptional organizational skills and strict attention to detail when managing spreadsheets and financial data.

title: CTO / Automation Engineer — US Credit Repair & Funding Company Scaling 5x (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
ABOUT US



Better Credit Challenge (BCC) is a US-based credit repair AND funding company.



We help people fix their credit AND get funded once their credit is strong enough.

Credit repair is the front door. Funding is the bigger door behind it.

Our clients come in with damaged credit. We help them clean it up. Then we help them

access business loans, personal funding, and capital for the goals they couldn't reach

before — homes, businesses, real estate investments.



We're currently at $10K/month recurring revenue with an 8-person team (operations side

is Philippines-based, like you'd be). We're hiring the person who will help us scale

to $50K/month, then $100K, then $500K.



Our stack: GoHighLevel, Stripe, Make.com, Zapier, Meta Business Manager, ManyChat, Smart Credit, Skool, Slack, Notion.





WHAT WE NEED



We are NOT hiring a builder.

We are hiring a PROACTIVE OPERATOR.



We need someone who:

? Sees what's broken before being asked

? Spots what's missing and brings solutions

? Doesn't wait for tasks — creates the roadmap

? Stays current with automation tools and brings new ideas every month

? When BCC misses an opportunity, you're the one who noticed first

? Understands you'll be building automation for TWO sides of the business —

   credit repair workflows AND funding workflows



If you wait for instructions and only do what's asked, this role is not for you.

Please don't apply — we will not consider you and it wastes both our time.



REQUIRED SKILLS



You must have ALL of the following:



? Deep GoHighLevel (GHL) experience — workflows, custom fields, pipelines, webhooks,

  calendars, phone routing

? UTM tracking and attribution — end-to-end (you can debug why a lead source isn't

  showing up)

?
 Pixel + CAPI — full integration knowledge

? Funnel design — cold lead all the way to retained client

? Zapier OR Make.com (preferably both)

? Stripe webhook handling

? Strong English (written + spoken) — you'll work directly with our US-based founder

? Documentation discipline — you write down what you build, every time



NICE-TO-HAVE (bonus skills, not required)

? ManyChat (Instagram/Facebook messenger automation)

? Google Tag Manager + GA4

? Twilio (phone routing under the hood)

?
 deliverability (SPF/DKIM/DMARC)

? Basic JavaScript for custom webhook handling

? TikTok Pixel + CAPI

? Smart Credit or credit-related platform experience

? Experience with funding / lending / financial services automation

? Familiarity with credit score data, dispute tracking, or financial KPIs





WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY



CREDIT REPAIR SIDE:

• Build and maintain GHL workflows for lead routing, client onboarding,

  payment recovery, and retention

• Architect Smart Credit integration deeper

• Build automation around dispute round tracking and client communications

• Manage CSM workflow automation (matching, onboarding, retention)



FUNDING SIDE:

• Build automation for funding eligibility detection

  (Month 4+ clients with score progress = funding candidates)

• Architect Funding Manager workflows (consultation booking, application tracking)

• Build integrations with lender platforms as we scale

• Create funding-specific lead capture and nurture funnels



ACROSS BOTH:

• Architect attribution across Meta Ads ? GHL ? Stripe ? revenue

• Connect Stripe, GHL, Slack, Drive, Smart Credit

• Document everything you build in Notion

• Daily Slack updates to leadership

• Weekly sync with Founder and Operations Manager





BIGGER PICTURE (where you grow)



• Audit our current systems and propose improvements (proactively, not when asked)

• Spot opportunities we're missing and bring them to us

• Build infrastructure that scales from $10K to $500K MRR without rewrites

• Architect the funding side as a major revenue stream

• Eventually lead a small automation team as we grow





COMPENSATION + GROWTH



STARTING SALARY: $800 USD/month



Why we start here:

We start every hire at $800/month because we test work ethic and proactivity first,

then reward fast for proven performance. We've built in automatic raises at Month 3

and Month 6 so strong performers see growth quickly.



Be honest with yourself: if $800 feels too low for your skill level, this isn't the role.

If you want to prove yourself and earn UP fast, this is the role.



GROWTH PATH:

? Month 3 (automatic raise): $1,000/month — given you're meeting basic expectations

? Month 6 (automatic raise): $1,200/month — given you're meeting basic expectations



Beyond Month 6, raises are performance-tied:



? Month 9-12: $1,400-1,600/month for strong performers

? Year 1-2: $1,700-2,000/month for proactive operators

? Year 2-3: $2,000-2,500/month for exceptional long-term performers



PERFORMANCE BONUSES at company milestones:

• $300 bonus when BCC hits $25K MRR

• $500 bonus at $50K MRR

• $1,000 bonus at $100K MRR

• $2,500 bonus at $500K MRR



Payment: Monthly via Wise (1st of each month)

Hours: 40-45 hours/week with 4-5 hours daily overlap with US business hours

Type: Independent contractor (full-time)



???????????????????????????????????????????????????

OUR HIRING PROCESS

???????????????????????????????????????????????????



We use a multi-round filter because the wrong hire costs us months.

Here's exactly what to expect (we're upfront so you can decide if it's worth your time):



???????????????????????????????????????????????????

ROUND 1: Application + cover letter

???????????????????????????????????????????????????

(This is what you're doing now)

???????????????????????????????????????????????????

ROUND 2: 30-minute video interview

???????????????????????????????????????????????????

With our Founder and Operations Manager



???????????????????????????????????????????????????

ROUND 3: 1-week UNPAID audit task

???????????????????????????????????????????????????

(Only top 7 candidates advance to this round)



You'll get view-only access to our actual GoHighLevel account.

You audit it and deliver a 1-2 page report on:

  - What's broken

  - What's missing

  - What we should fix first

  - Estimated business impact of each fix



This round filters out candidates who aren't serious about the role.

We're transparent: this round is UNPAID. The next round IS PAID.



???????????????????????????????????????????????????

ROUND 4: 1.5-WEEK PAID BUILD ROUND ($400 USD)

???????????????????????????????????????????????????

(Only top 2 finalists from the audit advance to this round)



This is where we see if you can EXECUTE what you proposed.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:



You'll be given:

• A sandbox GoHighLevel account (separate from our live BCC account)

• 1.5 weeks (10-11 working days)

• $400 USD paid via Wise within 48 hours of presentation

• Sample data + custom fields pre-populated so you can test as you build



YOUR JOB:



Take the TOP 2 PRIORITIES from your own audit and actually build them.

Not all your recommendations. Just the 2 most critical workflows.



We want QUALITY over QUANTITY:

? 2 workflows built EXCEPTIONALLY beats 5 workflows built sloppily

? YOU choose which 2 — based on your audit's priority ranking

? The choice itself tells us how you prioritize



For each workflow, you must deliver:

1. A fully functional workflow in the sandbox (working, tested, edge cases handled)

2. Written documentation (1 page max per workflow, plain English so anyone can follow)

3. A Loom video walkthrough (5-10 minutes) showing the workflow working

4. A live 30-minute Zoom presentation with Jamal + Mary Ann at the end



???????????????????????????????????????????????????

WHAT WE'RE EVALUATING (How We Pick Between The 2)

???????????????????????????????????????????????????



Both finalists will be technically competent — you made it through the audit.

The difference between you and the other finalist will show up in HOW you build,

not WHAT you build.



We're scoring 5 traits:



1. PROACTIVITY (most important)

   ? Did you go BEYOND what was asked?

   ? Did you add monitoring, alerts, or edge case handling we didn't request?

   ? Did you document something proactively because it would help BCC?

   ? Top performers do MORE than what's specified.

2. EXECUTION QUALITY

   ? Is the workflow clean and maintainable, or hacky?

   ? Did you handle edge cases (errors, duplicates, timing issues)?

   ? Could another engineer maintain this without asking you?

3. COMMUNICATION

   ? Can you explain technical decisions to non-technical leadership clearly?

   ? Do you defend your choices with logic (not ego)?

   ? When we push back on your approach, do you discuss or get defensive?



4. EDGE CASE THINKING

   ? We will ask: 'What happens if Stripe fires twice in 1 second?'

   ? We will ask: 'What happens if the workflow errors mid-execution?'

   ? We want to see you've thought about failure modes — not just happy path.

5. DOCUMENTATION

   ? Could a stranger pick up your docs and operate the workflow?

   ? Is it organized, scannable, useful?

   ? Or a wall of text written last-minute?



???????????????????????????????????????????????????

TIMELINE FOR THE 1.5 WEEKS

???????????????????????????????????????????????????



Day 1-2:   Plan what you're building, set up sandbox, design approach

Day 3-4:   Start building Workflow #1

Day 4:     Mary Ann sends a check-in message — your response is part of evaluation

Day 5-7:   Build Workflow #2, test both thoroughly

Day 8-9:   Polish, document, record Loom walkthrough

Day 10:    Live presentation with Jamal + Mary Ann (30 min Zoom)

Day 10-11: Payment processed via Wise



About the Day 4 check-in:

Mary Ann will message you on Day 4 asking how it's going.

Proactive operators will already have a status update ready.

Reactive builders will scramble or give vague answers.

How you respond is data for us.



???????????????????????????????????????????????????

PAYMENT TERMS

???????????????????????????????????????????????????



• $400 USD paid via Wise within 48 hours of your presentation

• Paid REGARDLESS of whether you're hired

• If you complete the deliverables, you get paid — period

• Work product (the workflows you build) belongs to BCC

• By accepting the build brief, you agree to these terms



???????????????????????????????????????????????????

ROUND 5: HIRING DECISION + IMMEDIATE START

???????????????????????????????????????????????????



After both finalist presentations, Jamal + Mary Ann compare side-by-side.

We make a decision within 48 hours and move fast on the offer.

Winner starts immediately at $800/month with the growth path described above.



Total timeline: 5-6 weeks from application to hire.

We move fast, but we won't compromise on fit.





???????????????????????????????????????????????????

HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

???????????????????????????????????????????????????



Send your complete application to: 



Your application must include ALL of the following:



1. COVER NOTE explaining specifically why YOU are the right fit

   (Not generic. Tell us specifically about BCC and this role — show us you read

   this post.)

2. PORTFOLIO or examples of past automation work

   (Screenshots, Loom videos, GitHub, anything showing real builds you've done.

   If you can't show real work, you're not the right hire for this level of role.)

3. FIRST LINE of your cover note must be the phrase:

   I see what's broken

   (Yes, exactly that phrase. This confirms you read this entire post carefully.

   Applications that don't include this phrase will not be reviewed.)

4. YOUR CURRENT MONTHLY RATE and what you're looking for

   (Be honest — we already told you we start at $800 with auto-raises to $1,200 by

   Month 6. If that doesn't work for you, don't apply. We'd rather know now than

   waste rounds.)

5. SOONEST YOU CAN START full-time





APPLICATIONS CLOSE: 

We respond to every application within 5 business days after applications close.





FINAL NOTE

We respect your time. We move fast. We pay fairly based on demonstrated performance.

We expect excellence.



If you want to help us build the company that fixes people's credit AND funds their next chapter — and you're ready to prove yourself to earn your way up — apply.



If you're not sure you're the right fit — don't apply. We'd rather hire one great

person rather than waste time with many average ones.



Looking forward to hearing from the right person.





Jamal

Better Credit Challenge

Grandmaster Solution LLC

title: Product Manager | Delivery Lead
description:
As the Project Manager / Delivery Lead, you'll be the bridge between technology delivery and business strategy — helping shape how technology initiatives are planned, prioritised, governed, and delivered across the organisation.



In this role, you will drive Agile ways of working, optimise delivery processes, and enable high-performing teams to deliver quality outcomes efficiently and consistently. Working across business analysis, quality assurance, and engineering functions, you will foster collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across the technology landscape.



Key Responsibilities



Delivery Planning & Execution

Lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of technology initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives, priorities, and operational outcomes.

Monitor delivery performance, risks, dependencies, and resource allocation to support successful project execution.

Drive accountability and transparency across delivery teams to achieve agreed outcomes and timelines.



Agile Leadership & Team Enablement

Champion Agile principles and best practices across teams, promoting a culture of collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement.

Support and empower teams to self-organise, make informed decisions, and operate effectively in fast-paced environments.

Coach teams and stakeholders on Agile methodologies, delivery practices, and workflow optimisation.



Facilitation & Delivery Governance

Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, and backlog refinement sessions.

Identify, manage, and remove impediments impacting team performance or delivery outcomes.

Establish and maintain effective governance practices to support delivery consistency, visibility, and quality assurance.



Stakeholder Engagement

Build strong relationships with business and technology stakeholders to align on priorities, delivery expectations, and strategic outcomes.

Support decision-making through clear reporting, analysis, and recommendations.



Process Improvement & Portfolio Insights

Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, planning accuracy, team velocity, and operational transparency across the technology function.

Partner with the IT and Product Manager to maintain visibility across the technology portfolio, including progress tracking, dependencies, risks, and delivery metrics.

Provide data-driven insights to support prioritisation, trade-off decisions, and strategic planning activities.



What You’ll Bring

Relevant tertiary qualifications and at least 3 years’ experience in technology delivery, strategic planning, business analysis, or management consulting.

Qualifications or certifications in Business Management, Project Management, Agile, or related disciplines will be highly regarded.

Strong understanding of project delivery, change management, and knowledge of technology delivery practices including SDLC, DevOps, release management, and delivery governance.

Demonstrated experience using Agile collaboration and delivery tools such as Jira and Confluence.

Exceptional stakeholder engagement, communication, and relationship management skills.

Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities across operational, financial, quality, and strategic objectives.

A proactive, adaptable, and solutions-focused mindset with the ability to take ownership and thrive in evolving or ambiguous environments.

title: Remote Wazuh Security Monitoring Specialist
description:
Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines



## Position Type



Part-Time Contractor



## About the Role



AI Hub is looking for a remote Wazuh Security Monitoring Specialist to help set up, manage, monitor, and maintain Wazuh security monitoring environments for business clients.



This role is for someone who understands Wazuh, security monitoring, log analysis, endpoint monitoring, alert review, and basic technical reporting.



The right person should be comfortable working with Wazuh agents, Wazuh server, indexer, dashboards, alerts, logs, vulnerability data, file integrity monitoring, configuration assessment, and basic i
 review workflows.



This is not a general virtual assistant role. This is a technical security monitoring role.



## About Wazuh



Wazuh is an open-source security monitoring platform used for endpoint detection and response, SIEM and log management, vulnerability detection, file integrity monitoring, configuration assessment, cloud security monitoring, container security monitoring, and compliance reporting support.



The specialist we hire must be able to work inside Wazuh, understand alerts, review security activity, and help document what is happening in the monitored environment.



## Main Responsibilities



* Set up and configure Wazuh environments under manager direction

* Install and help manage Wazuh agents on approved endpoints

* Monitor Wazuh dashboards for alerts, issues, and unusual activity

* Review endpoint activity, log data, vulnerabilities, configuration findings, and file integrity alerts

* Check agent status and confirm endpoints are reporting properly

* Review Wazuh alerts and identify items that need manager attention

* Prepare clear monitoring reports for management

* Document findings, actions taken, and open issues

* Help maintain Wazuh rules, dashboards, reports, and monitoring workflows

* Follow internal security, access control, and documentation procedures

* Escalate high-risk alerts or unclear findings to management

* Support client monitoring tasks for cloud, on-premise, or hybrid environments when assigned



## Required Skills



* Hands-on experience with Wazuh

* Basic understanding of SIEM and log management

* Basic understanding of endpoint detection and response

* Experience reviewing security alerts and system logs

* Familiarity with Linux servers

* Familiarity with Windows endpoint monitoring

* Understanding of Wazuh agents, server, indexer, and dashboard

* Ability to document technical findings clearly

* Ability to follow checklists and standard operating procedures

* Strong attention to detail

* Reliable communication

* Comfortable working remotely with task tracking and reporting tools



## Preferred Skills



* Experience with cloud security monitoring

* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud logs

* Experience with Docker or container monitoring

* Experience with vulnerability detection workflows

* Experience with file integrity monitoring

* Experience with compliance reporting support for PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, NIST, or similar frameworks

* Experience creating or reviewing technical reports

* Experience with ticketing tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, ClickUp, Trello, or similar tools



## Important Role Boundaries



This role supports security monitoring, documentation, and escalation.



This role does not make final legal, compliance, audit, or certification decisions.



This role does not guarantee that any client is compliant with HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOC 2, NIST, GDPR, or any other standard.



The specialist will help monitor technical controls, document findings, and escalate items for manager review.



## Work Schedule



This is a part-time remote role.



Expected schedule:



* 10 to 20 hours per week to start

* Monday through Friday availability preferred

* Daily monitoring check-ins required on assigned workdays

* Weekly reporting required

* Additional hours may be available based on workload and performance



The final schedule will be confirmed before hiring.



## Example Work Routine



A typical workday may include:



* Check Wazuh dashboard health

* Confirm active agents are connected

* Review new alerts

* Review vulnerability or configuration findings

* Identify urgent issues for escalation

* Update the monitoring tracker

* Prepare a short daily report

* Attend a short manager check-in when needed



## Compensation



Compensation will be discussed during the hiring process based on experience, technical skill level, schedule availability, and assigned responsibilities.



Payment schedule will be confirmed before work begins.



Possible payment structure may include:



* Hourly part-time pay

* Weekly or biweekly payment schedule

* Optional performance review after a trial period



No bonus, raise, or long-term hours are guaranteed. Any future increase or expanded responsibility must be approved by management.



## Who This Role Is Best For



This role is a good fit for someone who:



* Has real Wazuh experience

* Enjoys cybersecurity monitoring work

* Can follow technical checklists

* Can explain alerts in simple language

* Is reliable with daily reporting

* Can work independently

* Knows when to escalate instead of guessing

* Wants consistent part-time technical work



## Who Should Not Apply



Please do not apply if:



* You have never used Wazuh

* You are not comfortable reviewing security alerts

* You cannot work with Linux or endpoint monitoring tools

* You cannot provide clear daily updates

* You are looking for a non-technical virtual assistant role



## How to Apply



Please send the following:



1. Your resume or work profile

2. A short summary of your Wazuh experience

3. Examples of Wazuh tasks you have handled

4. Your experience with Linux, Windows, cloud, or container monitoring

5. Your available work schedule

6. Your expected hourly rate

7. Your preferred payment schedule

8. Any screenshots or sample reports you are allowed to share, with private client data removed



## Screening Questions



Please answer these questions when applying:



1. How long have you worked with Wazuh?

2. Have you installed or configured Wazuh agents before?

3. Have you monitored Wazuh alerts or dashboards before?

4. What operating systems have you monitored with Wazuh?

5. Have you worked with Wazuh vulnerability detection?

6. Have you worked with file integrity monitoring?

7. Have you reviewed logs from Windows, Linux, cloud, or Docker environments?

8. How would you report a high-risk alert to a manager?

9. What is your preferred weekly schedule?

10. What hourly rate are you requesting?



## Hiring Process



The hiring process may include:



* Resume review

* Written screening questions

* Short interview

* Technical discussion

* Wazuh task review or practical exercise

* Manager approval

* Paid trial period if selected



## Equal Opportunity Statement



AI Hub evaluates applicants based on job-related experience, technical skill, reliability, communication, schedule fit, and ability to perform the role responsibilities.

STEPHAN OLIVIER PHOTOGRAPHY & TOURS

Campbell River, BC  |  British Columbia and African Safaris



Virtual Assistant - Social Media, Content and Marketing

Part-time  |  10-15 hrs/week  |  Long-term  |  Remote

Immediate Start



About the Business

I'm Stephan, a wildlife and safari photographer based in Campbell River, British Columbia, Canada. I run Stephan Olivier Photography and Tours - a boutique photography and adventure tour business operating across two worlds: British Colombia, Canada wildlife tours featuring grizzly bears, eagles, whales, and marine wildlife, and photographic safaris to Africa - South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Tanzania, and Kenya.

My clients are photographers and wildlife lovers from across North America, the UK, and Europe. We run photographic tours, workshops, family holidays, couples getaways, and honeymoon packages. The business is growing and I need help building the online presence and marketing engine that matches the quality of the experiences we deliver.



The Role

I'm looking for a reliable, creative VA who can take work off my plate and run with it. You'll be working directly with me across social media, content creation, video editing,
 marketing, and marketing setup. This is a long-term position - I'm not looking for someone to hand off a one-time project. I want someone who learns the brand, grows with the business, and becomes a real part of the team.

This starts at 10-15 hours per week with room to grow. If you're the right person, this won't stay small.



What You'll Be Doing

Social Media (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube)

• Creating and scheduling carousel posts - we aim for 2 to 3 per week

• Writing captions that sound human and on-brand - wildlife stories, safari 
nts, photography tips

• Repurposing existing content across platforms

• Managing hashtags, scheduling, and basic engagement

• Tracking what's working and flagging it to me



Video Editing and Content Creation

• Editing wildlife and safari footage into polished short-form videos (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts)

• Adding music, text overlays, colour grading - keeping it cinematic and on-brand

• Pulling clips from raw footage and turning them into multiple content pieces

• Creating Canva graphics for carousels, marketing materials, and promotional content



 Marketing (Kit / formerly ConvertKit)

• Writing and scheduling
 campaigns and newsletters

• Helping set up automations, sequences, and welcome flows

• Keeping the
 list organised and segmented



Marketing and Systems Setup

• Helping build and maintain a content calendar

• Light updates to our Squarespace website

• Supporting tour promotions on the WeTravel booking platform

• Setting up workflows and templates so content creation gets faster over time



Who You Are

You don't need to be an expert in everything from day one - but you do need to be a fast learner with a genuine interest in wildlife, photography, travel, or the outdoors. The brand has a distinct voice and visual style, and I need someone who cares enough to get it right.

• Know Squarespace or similar website platforms

• Have experience with WeTravel or any booking or tour platform

• Have photography knowledge or a genuine passion for wildlife



Tools We Use

• Instagram, TikTok, YouTube

• Canva (brand account with assets ready)

• Kit (ConvertKit) for
 marketing

• Squarespace for the website

• WeTravel for tour bookings

• Outlook for

Compensation and Details

• Part-time: 10-15 hours per week to start

• Long-term position - we're building something, not just filling a gap

• Rate - Starting rate is $
/month depending on experience, with room to grow as the business grows

How to Apply

This is a genuine long-term opportunity with a small business that does meaningful work. If you're looking for something you can be proud of and a role where your effort actually shows - this is it.



Thank you for applying.  

Kind Regards

Stephan

Campbell River, BC, Canada

title: Social Media Content Strategist *Superstar Only*

title: Cloud Migration Engineer (GCP ? Azure)
description:
Company Overview

We are a digital health platform delivering AI-driven music therapy solutions to nursing home facilities across the United States. Their current infrastructure runs on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), utilizing NestJS/TypeScript microservices, Python FastAPI ML services, MySQL 8, Redis Cluster, Pub/Sub, Flutter mobile applications, and an Angular dashboard.



Role Overview

We are looking for a highly experienced Cloud Migration Engineer to lead and execute a full migration from GCP to Microsoft Azure. This is a hands-on technical role for someone with proven real-world production migration experience using both gcloud and az CLI environments. The selected candidate will work closely with the engineering team to architect, execute, and complete the migration while ensuring system stability, scalability, and minimal downtime.



Key Responsibilities

• Lead the end-to-end migration of Rubato’s infrastructure from GCP to Azure.

• Map existing GCP services to Azure equivalents and recommend the best architecture solutions.

• Execute phased migration plans with minimal or zero downtime.

• Handle cross-cloud migration of MySQL databases and Redis state management.

• Configure and manage Azure infrastructure components including networking, security, storage, and identity access management.

• Conduct knowledge transfer sessions and provide post-migration support documentation.

• Collaborate closely with engineering and DevOps teams throughout the migration process.



Current GCP Stack

• Cloud Run

• Pub/Sub

• Cloud SQL MySQL

• Memorystore Redis

• Secret Manager

• Cloud Storage

• IAM



Target Azure Stack

• Azure Container Apps or AKS

• Azure Service Bus

• Azure Database for MySQL

• Azure Cache for Redis

• Azure Key Vault

• Azure Blob Storage

• Entra ID / RBAC



Must-Have Requirements

• Proven production-level GCP ? Azure migration experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with:

o Azure Container Apps or AKS

o Azure Service Bus

o Azure Database for MySQL

o Azure Cache for Redis

o Azure Key Vault

• Experience working with containerized NestJS/TypeScript and Python FastAPI services.

• Strong MySQL operational knowledge including replication, backup/restore, and cross-cloud migration.

• Solid networking fundamentals including VNets, private endpoints, DNS, and egress control.

• Comfortable working directly with cloud CLI tools (gcloud and az).

• Strong documentation and communication skills for architecture mapping and knowledge transfer.



Nice-to-Have

• DevOps/SRE background.

• Experience supporting healthcare or HIPAA-adjacent platforms.

• Experience with Terraform or Infrastructure-as-Code tooling.

Has a can-do attitude and can adapt to process changes

Is open to feedback and treats it as an opportunity to improve

Is responsive in Slack and ClickUp during working hours

Can document actions, updates, and observations clearly and consistently

Knows when to flag issues early instead of reacting too late

Can help keep onboarding tasks, client requests, and internal updates organized



What You’ll Actually Be Doing

You will not be expected to improvise or create your own system from scratch. You will be working inside a clear process and helping make sure that process is followed properly.

Support Account Managers during client onboarding

Ensure all onboarding requirements are completed fully and on time

mbers who consistently bring value to our partners and clients.

Your resume as a Google Drive link

A 1-minute voice recording as a Google Drive link explaining your experience related to this role

title: Social Media Content Producer *Superstar Only*
description:
We're hiring a Social Media Content Producer to own the daily execution, publishing, and production operations behind our short-form content engine across Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. This is the hands-on execution role on the social team. You take creative direction and turn it into finished, polished, published content - fast, clean, and on-brand, every single day.



You will be working directly with a creator who has over 4 million followers across platforms, with Instagram as the primary channel. Our content operation is structured like a studio with batch production, performance metrics, and AI-native systems. You report to the Content Strategist who sets the creative direction and generates the ideas. Your job is to bring those ideas to life - editing, designing, scheduling, publishing, tracking performance, and keeping the entire production machine running smoothly.



This is a full-time remote position. We are looking for a fast, detail-oriented executor who can produce high-quality short-form content at volume, manage publishing workflows across multiple platforms, and actively use AI tools to increase speed and output. A genuine interest in health, beauty, and strong visual aesthetics is essential - this is the world we operate in, and you need to live and breathe it.



Responsibilities

- Produce 2 to 3 short-form videos and supporting graphics per day, including editing, trimming, captioning, and polishing content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

- Execute on creative briefs and direction provided by the Content Strategist, turning concepts into finished, platform-ready assets.

- Design on-brand visuals such as carousels, text graphics, thumbnails, and infographics that support the creator's style and messaging.

- Plan, schedule, and publish short-form content across all platforms while maintaining a balanced mix of educational, inspirational, and trend-based formats.

- Follow short-form trends including audio, hooks, captions, and editing styles, and flag relevant opportunities to the Content Strategist.

- Monitor performance metrics weekly and provide insights, recommendations, and data summaries based on watch time, retention, views, and engagement.

- Source and organize trending sounds, audio, and reference content to support the Content Strategist's ideation process.

- Coordinate collaboration posts and identify smart opportunities for creator crossovers and partnership content.

- Keep systems clean in Asana and Google Drive, ensuring clear task ownership, file naming, version control, and a predictable content runway.

- Use AI tools to streamline editing, captioning, clipping, and repurposing workflows to increase daily output and reduce turnaround time.

- Continuously improve and document production workflows to increase the efficiency and scalability of the content system.



Requirements

- 3+ years of experience creating and publishing short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, and/or YouTube Shorts with proven results.

- Genuine interest in health, beauty, and aesthetics. You naturally follow this space, understand the visual standards, and have an eye for what looks premium.

- Editing and design expertise in short-form video editing using Premiere Pro, CapCut, or Final Cut, and strong design ability using Canva or Photoshop, including thumbnails, carousels, text graphics, and supporting visuals.

- Strong ability to take creative direction and execute it accurately and quickly with minimal revision cycles.

- Deep platform fluency across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and emerging formats, with a clear understanding of distribution mechanics and platform culture.

- Experience managing posting schedules and publishing workflows across multiple platforms, with strong attention to detail, file organization, and systems management.

- Ability to track and interpret performance metrics such as watch time, retention, views, and engagement, and surface insights to inform strategy.

- AI-forward operator who actively uses AI tools in editing and production workflows. Bonus for familiarity with tools such as Runway, VEO or Flow, ChatGPT, or Claude.

- Excellent communication skills for collaborating with the Content Strategist, editors, and cross-functional teams.

- Ability to handle multiple tasks effectively while operating in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

- Must submit a strong portfolio demonstrating editing, design, and creative execution across multiple short-form formats.

- Recognized for exceptional achievements such as attaining Latin Honors (Summa Cum Laude, Magna Cum Laude, Cum Laude), performance awards, or demonstrating fast career progression into higher roles.



Results

- Social content consistently published within 24 to 48 hours of long-form production wrap.

- Sustained growth in high-quality engagement including shares, saves, retention, and audience sentiment.

- A cohesive, premium social presence that reinforces and amplifies the creator's broader ecosystem.

- Clean, organized production systems with predictable output and minimal missed deadlines.



Requirements for Effective Remote Work

- Reliable computer or laptop capable of video editing.

- High-speed internet connection plus backup.

- Conducive work environment.



Working Schedule

- Full-time remote position.



Compensation

- Salary will be based on skills, speed, portfolio output, and experience.



Benefits

- Competitive salary.

- Paid Time Off from day one, increasing to 10 days annually after six months with the company.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

 Page:

www.

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

[After Regularization]

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.
