title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
About the role

Atlas Geotech LLC builds spatial data solutions for the real estate and insurance industries — property hazard disclosures, cost estimates, and risk models. The accuracy and usefulness of our data, web apps, and information products they generate is the whole product, so we're hiring a QA specialist with genuine GIS expertise and an obsessive eye for detail.



This is a remote role with room to grow with responsibility. You'll work primarily async, with a short daily overlap with US Pacific Time.



What you'll do

GIS data & output QA — the core of the role

Verify how we use the data:  the highest-value checks: is a hazard flag derived from the correct layer, does an address geocode to the right parcel, is an cost figure computed correctly? Validate outputs against known-good reference cases.

Verify our apps display the right thing:  maps, layers, and overlays render the correct data in the correct place, at the right zoom, with styling that reads clearly.

Verify our reports tell the right story:  hazard disclosures and replacement cost reports are correct, coherent, and sensible — e.g., a parcel inside a fire-hazard zone is never reported as low-risk, figures are plausible, and the narrative matches the underlying data.

Validate spatial data:  SRID / coordinate-reference-system correctness, geometry validity (ST_IsValid — self-intersections, invalid polygons), topology issues (gaps, overlaps, slivers), and the integrity of joins between spatial and tabular attributes.

Spot-check positional accuracy:  confirm hazard zones overlay parcels correctly, addresses land in the right place, and reprojections (e.g., EPSG:4326 ? 3857) haven't silently shifted geometry.

Verify GeoServer & GeoNode:  WMS/WFS GetCapabilities, layer bounding boxes, SLD styling renders as intended; and GeoNode metadata / layer configuration is complete and correct.

Validate data parity across environments/migrations:  confirm a migrated or cloud copy of our data matches the source — row counts, geometry integrity, and query results identical across environments.

Web app & API QA

Test our API endpoints:  response schemas, status codes, pagination, auth, and the correctness of returned JSON and images.

Test our map front-ends:  layer toggles, popups, click handlers, coordinate display, zoom behavior, tile loading, large-payload performance, plus basic cross-browser/responsive checks.

Write clear, reproducible bug reports:  steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual, severity — and verify fixes.

Required

GIS fundamentals — the key requirement:  spatial queries, coordinate reference systems, projections and datum transformations, when to use raster vs. vector, geometry types, topology, and spatial data-quality concepts. This is the heart of the role — strong GIS judgment matters more than any single tool.

Hands-on with a desktop GIS:  QGIS or ArcGIS/Esri. If your background is ArcGIS and you haven't used the open-source stack yet, that's completely fine — the fundamentals transfer well and we'll help you ramp on QGIS/PostGIS.

Spatial SQL in PostGIS —  or a genuine willingness to learn it quickly (if you've written attribute queries or Definition Queries in ArcGIS, you're closer than you think).

A real eye for detail:  you notice when something is subtly wrong, not just obviously broken.

Communication:  clear written English and disciplined documentation habits.

Self-direction:  comfortable working independently and async.

Python —  even at a basic level. We'd love someone who can grow into scripting data-validation checks with GeoPandas/Shapely, testing APIs with requests/httpx, and eventually writing automated tests (pytest, Playwright). Tell us what you've built, however small.

Logistics

Type:  Remote

Hours:  40

Overlap:  a short daily window with US Pacific Time

Rate:  

Equipment:  you provide your own computer and reliable internet.

Selection process

Strong applicants will be invited to a short video interview, including a brief walkthrough of how you'd approach QA on a sample layer or report — a conversation, not homework. We're looking for how you think and what you notice.



How to apply

To show us you read this carefully, start your application with the word “isoline.” Applications without it won't be reviewed. 



In your message, please include:



a short description of your GIS background and the tools you use most.

one example of a data-quality or software bug you caught that others missed, and how you found it.

your Python experience, if any (be honest — “basic” is fine).

If you love experimenting, testing, and refining campaigns until you hit that perfect balance of reach, clicks, and conversions, this might be for you.



You’ll be helping us plan, launch, and optimize ad campaigns on Google and Meta 
/Instagram). We value people who can blend creativity with data—those who can see the numbers but still think like a storyteller.



What You’ll Do

• Create and manage ad campaigns across Google Ads and Meta platforms

• Research keywords and audiences to make sure we’re reaching the right people

• Write and test ad copy that connects and converts

• Monitor performance, track ROI, and prepare short reports that are easy to understand

• Share new ideas to improve campaign results

• Collaborate with a small, supportive team that values clear communication and ownership



What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience running paid ads on Google and

• Ability to analyze data and make smart, data-driven decisions

• Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, or Tag Manager

• Strong written English skills

• Bonus: experience with e-commerce or lead-generation campaigns

• Extra bonus: a basic understanding of SEO or landing page optimization





How to Apply



Send us:

- Your resume

- Links or screenshots of ad campaigns you’ve managed (if available)



A quick answer to this:

“What’s one campaign you’re proud of, and what made it work?”



Please apply directly here on OLJ.



We read every application carefully :)

title: help me to understand trading strategy  bootcamp
description:
Looking for a Detail-Oriented Trading Bootcamp Mentor / Study Partner (Paid)



I'm looking for someone patient, highly detail-oriented, and visually minded to help me deeply understand a trading strategy bootcamp.

The goal is simple: I want to go through the entire bootcamp with you until I fully understand the strategy — especially the backtesting process. I need someone who can break everything down clearly and teach it in a way that sticks.

What the role involves:

Watching the bootcamp videos 

Pausing frequently to take detailed notes

Organizing concepts logically

Creating clean summaries and cheat sheets

Labeling charts clearly

Turning screenshots into step-by-step visual explanations

Explaining the strategy in simple, visual terms

Guiding me through the backtesting process until I can do it confidently on my own

Ideal person:

Excellent at learning complex material quickly

Strong visual teacher (you love using charts, arrows, annotations, etc.)

Patient and detail-oriented

Good at explaining concepts from beginner to advanced level

Experience with trading concepts is a big plus, but not required if you're a strong learner/teacher

This will be a longer-term commitment until I fully understand the material.
